Add a computer

About five minutes on a Windows computer. You need to be an administrator on that computer.

  1. 1
    Confirm
  2. 2
    Install

    You get a setup file to open on the computer you are adding.

  3. 3

Adding a computer does not order antivirus or create a charge. Need help with Mac or Linux?
